verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a self-serve account export through its Marketing API that can generate and download a full account export (docs-16), and a community user confirms exporting their subscriber list themselves (comm-13). Nothing in the evidence shows which fields that export includes or what file format it uses. missing for 10: confirmation that custom fields, tags, engagement history (opens/clicks) and the suppression/unsubscribed list are included, documentation of an open file format (e.g. CSV), and independent hands-on confirmation of a complete export.
